name: alert-dialog
description: Native guidance for a modal decision with .alert, using button roles and prepared copy while keeping the system presentation.
docs: Present a decision with the native `.alert` modifier and give each button a role: `.destructive` for the irreversible choice and `.cancel` for the way out. The system owns layout, typography, blur, and VoiceOver focus; the registry adds no wrapper because the modifier and roles are the entire treatment.
accessibility: Native alerts move VoiceOver focus into the dialog and restore it on dismissal.
Button roles drive the destructive tint and the cancel position without custom styling.
Copy must state the consequence; the alert never relies on the tint to convey danger.
